proposals.evidence: DEDR 648 full article (p. 62) gives Kor. (M.) ojji to say. Te. ūraka ( neg. gerund of *ūr-), uraka, uṟaka silently, quietly, not speaking; merely, simply, vainly; roda noise, outcry, uproar; ? rō̃ju to pant, gasp; n. panting; rō Bhat ojjɨ “to say” matches Lindgren Koraga ojjɨ “say” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
